title: DecisionThresholdPolicy Contract
description: OD-18: a Jev decision is only actionable when its confidence meets the policy threshold bound to the resolved model. The low_confidence_action enum is deliberately closed to authority-narrowing outcomes (RE_EVALUATE, DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK, HUMAN_GATE, BLOCKED); no action widens scope, authority, qualification, or effects. PROCEED is a runtime evaluation outcome of confidence >= min_confidence and is intentionally NOT a member of this enum.
